candidate.role: opt-in, independent untraced reference only; runner reports selected Test262 execution and scalar differential probes

families.name: script grammar, static semantics, and early errors
families.referenceExecution: pin-specific script parse and selected Test262 cases; no full harness
families.blocker: Need source-site mapping, exact early errors, AST identity and versioned traces without running opaque engine262 state.

families.name: primitive values and coercions
families.authoritativeTracing: partial primitive arithmetic phases in src/spec-operations.js; not engine262 execution substitution
families.blocker: Object ToPrimitive, observable getters and Symbol conversions remain unowned; Number parsing/formatting and typed arithmetic remain declared host scalar leaves. See docs/OWNED_ARITHMETIC.md and coverage/engine262-inventory.json.

families.name: lexical environments, bindings, and closures
families.blocker: Engine262 execution contexts and environment records are live objects, not serializable controlled guest-owned state.

families.name: object internal methods, proxies, reflection
families.blocker: Proxy traps, property attributes, prototype chains, and accessors need full state and dynamic effect ordering.

families.name: functions, this, completion and exception propagation
families.blocker: Abrupt completions, native re-entry, caller frames, generator state and host exceptions are not owned.

families.name: promises, microtasks, and job queues
families.blocker: Agent job queue is not the tracer's explicit queue; exact scheduling/replay must be designed first.

families.name: modules, linking, and dynamic source
families.blocker: Module resolver/cache/linking and dynamic import/eval require source registration, module records and replayable host hooks.

families.name: intrinsics and standard library
families.blocker: Per-intrinsic/clause mapping to spec text, profile switches, native hooks and full Test262 fixtures not completed.

families.name: agents, shared memory, GC and weak references
families.blocker: Need agent sequencing, typed backing-store coherence, GC/weak semantics and replayable native resources.

families.name: ECMA-402 and locale data
families.blocker: No audited ECMA-402 implementation or pinned locale/Unicode data.

families.name: Node/browser native host services
families.blocker: Web IDL, Node built-ins, real ABI bridge, activation retention and effects are outside the current mock host.

families.name: normative operation provenance and full model-visibility proof
families.blocker: AST callbacks alone are not normative operation logs; typed mutation catalog/visibility validator must be complete.

required: Pinned and audited per-clause/per-intrinsic specification coverage
Spec phases executed with owned/serializable state, not mirrored opaque engine objects
No guest state or host callbacks escape trace authorization
Independent deterministic replay of both results and normative observable ordering
Full Test262 runner and declared pass/skip/fail ledger
Node/browser integration and native consistency fixtures
